tests.runtime: edivo-backend:r05 isolated current sources read-only, network none, 2 CPUs/1536MiB/128 PIDs

count_policy: 119 initial distinct cases +2 newly added boundary cases +1 new gain case; gain reexecution is not counted twice. These totals include69 historical preview cases and53 new final compositor cases, not full-project regression totals.

host_execution.reason: Host has no FFmpeg/FFprobe; all those real cases were executed in Docker instead.

progress_units: progress-units.json: out_time_us=out_time_ms=1000000 for exactly1s/30 frames; both are microseconds
audio_gains: audio-gain.json: original0/0.5/1/2 and background0/0.5/1 measured independently through decoded AAC PCM; no automatic normalization

visual_evidence.observations: Three distinct top/center/bottom overlays readable and inside the canvas; accents, quotes, colon, backslash and percent remain literal. White/blue outline and white plain styles visible.

limitations: Synthetic automated audio levels do not prove intelligibility or subjective quality for arbitrary media.
The preserved R04 amix normalize=0 semantics can clip for arbitrary high-gain sources/mixes; no new limiter is silently introduced.
One frame at30fps +1ms is the validation tolerance; not frame-perfect source editing.
Worker/publication/DB/API/browser are later gates and are not claimed by compositor-only QA.
